text: Deploying a Bicep file is a single Azure CLI command, scoped to an existing resource group, supplying whatever the file's param declarations need.
What-if reports exactly what would be created, modified, or left unchanged, without touching anything — the same review-before-you-commit idea this course keeps coming back to.
Run it from inside VS Code instead, and the Bicep extension opens a deployment pane showing live progress resource by resource — a convenience over the CLI, not a different deployment.
Every deployment targets a scope. A resource-group deployment fits almost everything in this course; a subscription-scoped deployment is for things that live above any single resource group.
One command, a dry run first, a live view if you want it. Next up: deploying Azure SQL with Bicep.
